provenance.prompt: Create one original sprite atlas: an exact 4-column by 2-row grid of eight separate, complete, right-facing full-body reverse basketball layup poses for Juniper Vale, supporting athlete cell1 of the Chicago Condas. Juniper is an adult human woman with light warm skin, dark eyes, abundant dark-purple curls gathered high with a small gold tie, compact natural athletic proportions, a plain blank purple sleeveless uniform with gold trim, dark knee pads, and purple/gold basketball shoes. Preserve her identity, face, high curls, compact build, and blank uniform consistently across all eight drawings; use no numerals or lettering. All figures are the same scale, evenly spaced with generous transparent gutters, uncropped with clear hands and feet. Use polished 1990s arcade basketball sprite art with crisp readable pixels and consistent outlines. Every hand is empty because the game renders its own basketball. Row-major pose sequence for a reverse layup: (1) approach along the baseline, (2) gather with the ball-side arm pulled in but empty hand, (3) plant beneath the hoop with the torso beginning to turn away, (4) leap across the lane toward the far side of the rim, (5) reverse-side one-hand release behind the head at the action's high point, (6) airborne follow-through with the releasing arm extended, (7) descend beyond the hoop, (8) balanced landing facing right. Keep a clean orthographic three-quarter side view and consistent baseline. No ball, hoop, court, floor, shadow, lettering, numerals, logos, props, border, panels between figures, fantasy anatomy, duplicated or merged bodies. Transparent background throughout.

review.notes: The raw generated sheet has a painted translucent backdrop and is rejected as a clean transparent atlas. It has eight complete, separate alpha>=64 body components; the component-only packer isolates the original figures and excludes the backdrop. The packed atlas was reviewed on light and dark grounds and has clean transparent gutters. Juniper remains an adult human woman with light warm skin, dark eyes, abundant dark-purple high curls with gold tie, compact natural proportions, blank purple/gold uniform, dark knee pads and matching shoes. Hands are empty. J.01 confirms no fixed-side anatomy mark or directional detail, so reviewed body mirroring is safe.
